scope: Official-source audit; reported dataset sizes are not local inventory counts

datasets.question: RQ2
datasets.modalities: RGB phone/webcam video; heterogeneous resolutions; nominal <30 FPS
datasets.annotation: Participants self-record based on KSS guidance: Alert1-3, Low Vigilance6-7, Drowsy8-9. Codes0/5/10 are not KSS scores.
datasets.repeated_measures: 3 videos/person; all clips/derivatives must share participant partition
datasets.splitting: Official five folds of12 people. Ingestion preserves archive folder; generated folds are separately named, never passed off as official folds.
datasets.ground_truth_quality: drowsiness, weak video-level supervision; no guaranteed label on each frame/clip
datasets.download_audit: Official Google Drive HTTP200: Fold1_part1.zip through Fold5_part2.zip (10 files); 111.3GB reported; no videos downloaded
datasets.license: Research access and citation instructions on official page; no explicit general redistribution license identified. Only36/60 participants consent to face publication; eligible IDs must be verified.
datasets.confounds: 51men/9women, age20-59, mostlyyoung; device/FPS/illumination/background/task/time-of-day; demographics and recordings repeated within person
datasets.atc_relevance: Useful drowsiness encoder candidate; household RGB speech-free conditions differ from ATC and DROZY IR
datasets.blocker: Videos absent locally; large download not authorized; no installed/validated video landmark detector or author-verified publication identity list
datasets.implemented: Offline metadata/identity/checksum ingestion and generated subject-fold adapter, tested on explicitly synthetic engineering fixtures

datasets.question: RQ3
datasets.duration_reported: 1000+ camera-hours reported in dataset README; unique-session totals not verified
datasets.modalities: RGB and IR, five viewpoints: up,left_up,left,front,down
datasets.target: Awake/Fatigue directory categories; drowsiness signs and yawning events
datasets.label_type: category/event; not a verified occupational fatigue scale
datasets.annotation: 20 public yawning JSONs, 266 start/end pairs validated; no released blinking JSON in audited tree. Time units and camera clock mapping not yet verified.
datasets.repeated_measures: Multiple viewpoints/modalities from same recording group; group-ID to participant/session identity needs author confirmation
datasets.splitting: Released tree describes Train IDs0065-0074, Test0075-0084; directory IDs alone are not assumed to prove participant disjointness
datasets.ground_truth_quality: Yawning is a behavioral event, insufficient for fatigue binary targets. Category name Fatigue does not validate fatigue severity.
datasets.download_audit: Git tree has no source mp4/avi/mov; README points to Baidu shared link, code qwba. HTTP200 password gate reached; file listing, size and authorized source videos not retrieved.
datasets.license: Repository MIT text covers software/documentation. Explicit biometric-video/annotation usage and redistribution rights require clarification; paper PDF access returned403.
datasets.confounds: Viewpoint, headpose, occlusion, RGB/IR, illumination, repeated-camera observations and possible subject/camera overlap
datasets.atc_relevance: Cross-camera robustness is relevant; need consistent labels, known timestamps, actual paired camera data and person-disjoint evaluation
datasets.blocker: No source video, no verified participant/session mapping or source-video license, annotation units unresolved
datasets.implemented: Actual small-annotation audit; offline video adapter requiring explicit identity map, checksum duplicate guard and camera schema

datasets.question: RQ4
datasets.modalities: Driver videos; RGB-D/Kinect feature framework described by paper; exact downloadable stream inventory unverified
datasets.annotation: Paper section5.3 describes sleep-deprived vs sufficient-sleep recordings. No validated per-video fatigue questionnaire or physiological severity measure established from accessible description.
datasets.ground_truth_quality: Fatigue-related induction condition; substantial overlap with sleepiness. Not direct ATC occupational fatigue ground truth.
datasets.splitting: 17driver groups make person-disjoint evaluation feasible if IDs are supplied. Paper uses300frame sliding windows/stride5; original-video and participant grouping required to avoid near-duplicate leakage.
datasets.download_audit: README requests contact fanliu@hhu.edu.cn for download link; no direct source videos in repository. No contact message sent.
datasets.license: No repository license or dataset redistribution grant identified; author permission required
datasets.confounds: Sleep loss, recording time, person, background, camera and overlapping clips; induction is not measured fatigue severity
datasets.atc_relevance: Potential controlled sleep-loss comparison; need label instrument and protocol before claiming fatigue classifier
datasets.blocker: Author-gated access; no videos, subject metadata or approved use agreement

datasets.question: RQ4
datasets.duration_reported: Paper5seconds-2minutes, mean30FPS; README says5-60seconds; release mismatch requires clarification
datasets.modalities: Self-captured audiovisual face video in everyday situations
datasets.target: Observer-rated facial fatigue appearance with self-evaluation context
datasets.annotation: Three raters score audiovisual evidence; averaged score normalized. Paper calls dataset DLFD, repository LFD. Binary thresholds and full participant-to-video manifest require release audit.
datasets.ground_truth_quality: Observer-rated appearance, not independently validated occupational fatigue measurement; speech content, mood and facial traits may affect ratings
datasets.splitting: 32subjects reported, repeated videos; participant-independent split feasible only with verified IDs. Published scores are not reproduced locally.
datasets.download_audit: README: obtain dataset by contacting authors; pretrained weights withheld. No downloadable original dataset found in repository.
datasets.license: No explicit code/dataset license identified; paper license is not a dataset redistribution grant
datasets.confounds: Rater expectation, audio semantics, mood, daily scenario, time, device and identity; thresholds distinguish rated appearance rather than clinical truth
datasets.atc_relevance: Natural facial-fatigue appearance is relevant exploratory evidence; does not establish ATC state labels

datasets.question: RQ4 alternative
datasets.duration_reported: about50minute sessions, mean57.4minutes; repeated up to8/person
datasets.modalities: Facial video30FPS, task reaction time, self-report
datasets.target: Mental fatigue measured using18-item visual analogue scale before/after session
datasets.label_type: continuous self-report0-10 and study-derived categories; labels at session endpoints only
datasets.annotation: Validated self-report instrument plus association with reaction time; first/last clip supervision, intermediate clips unlabeled
datasets.ground_truth_quality: Closer to measured mental fatigue than appearance alone; sparse labels and task/disease/age confounds remain
datasets.splitting: Repeated sessions must be grouped by24people; access needed to validate IDs and split manifests
datasets.download_audit: Paper Data Availability explicitly limits data to individuals listed on study IRB. Code alone is public.
datasets.license: Sensitive clinical video; IRB-restricted, no open redistribution permission
datasets.confounds: Older adults with mild cognitive impairment, masks, task performance and sparse pre/post measurements; large ATC population gap
datasets.atc_relevance: Useful model for designing consented ATC fatigue measurement protocol; not a presently available training corpus

datasets.question: RQ4 alternative
datasets.duration_reported: Task-round sessions; absolute visual clock not verified
datasets.modalities: 2FPS facial landmarks, EEG, performance, cumulative event self-report
datasets.target: Task difficulty/fatigue-related button events, not dense fatigue/non-fatigue labels
datasets.annotation: Existing local audit:77sessions,20numeric IDs differs from paper19/76; day-b IDs must merge with same person
datasets.ground_truth_quality: Weak event proxy; absent button presses do not establish non-fatigue
datasets.splitting: Verified person/day mapping needed; ambiguity blocks supervised window labels
datasets.download_audit: Local landmark/event/performance archives already audited by previous experiment; no EEG analysis
datasets.license: MIT software; paper data-sharing approval not blanket biometric redistribution permission
datasets.confounds: Difficulty, learning, stimulus type, day and incomplete clock mapping;2FPS does not validate blink duration
datasets.atc_relevance: Cognitive task context informative; no supervised fatigue classifier justified yet
datasets.status: AUDIT ONLY — NO VALID DENSE TARGET
datasets.blocker: Label semantics, participant discrepancy and timing unresolved
